newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Codelco El Teniente copper output at 350,000 t.
newsitem.headline: Codelco El Teniente copper output at 350,000 t.

text.p: The manager of Codelco's El Teniente mine, Fernando Riveri, said on Tuesday the mine's copper output will recover to reach 350,000 tonnes in 1996 and should maintain that level in 1997.
"We are very sure of 350,000 tonnes this year. We hope to produce 350,000 tonnes in 1997." he told a media briefing.

He also forecast copper prices in 1997 to range between $0.90 and $0.95 a pound, although he would prefer $1 a pound. Riveri, in Singapore for the signing of a smelter agreement with a Thai company, said Asian sales of Codelco should reach 800,000 tonnes in 1997 against an estimated 600,000 tonnes this year.
